question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        c.constructor_id,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        r.year,
        SUM(rs.points) as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings rs
    JOIN races r ON rs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name, r.year
),
driver_best AS (
    SELECT 
        r2.constructor_id,
        r.year,
        MAX(r2.points) as max_driver_points
    FROM results r2
    JOIN races r ON r2.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r2.constructor_id, r.year
)
SELECT 
    cy.constructor_id,
    cy.constructor_name,
    cy.year,
    cy.constructor_points,
    db.max_driver_points,
    cy.constructor_points + db.max_driver_points as combined_points
FROM constructor_yearly cy
JOIN driver_best db ON cy.constructor_id = db.constructor_id AND cy.year = db.year
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
